versions.changelog:
- Added a "Configuration" section to the documentation specifying the required FUNDRAISEUP_API_KEY environment variable.
- No functional or API changes; documentation update only.

FundraiseUp Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the FundraiseUp skill.
- Supports interacting with the FundraiseUp REST API to manage donations, supporters, recurring plans, campaigns, and donor portal access.
- Enables processing both online and offline donations and retrieving fundraising analytics.
- Offers integration with nonprofit CRM systems.
- Compatible with bash_tool, web_search, and web_fetch environments.
